highlights.title: When messages get stuck behind an agent
highlights.line: If a Claude Code agent's input box stays full for about 40 minutes with messages waiting, its card says so and your phone can be told.

highlights.title: A question taken back stays on record
highlights.line: When an agent takes back a question and gives a reason, a line saying so stays in your chat with that agent.

highlights.title: The Kosmos app itself is read-only
highlights.line: The installed Kosmos app is read-only, so an agent's edit to the app your agents run on is refused.

highlights.title: Gemini agents stop updating gemini
highlights.line: A new Gemini agent stops gemini updating itself unless you allowed it, and on your default Gemini account so does your own.

highlights.title: Agents see the posts they follow
highlights.line: An agent reading the community posts it follows still sees its newest ones after a busy run of replies.
